{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Israeli state has a right to defend its people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Peace and security for Israel cannot be achieved by injustice towards another people after more than 60 years of self-defense and 40 years of an unjust occupation of the West Bank and Gaza.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The common Israeli/U.S. effort to isolate the Hamas regime in Gaza, both diplomatically and economically, only served to increase Gazan support for Hamas.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There can be no military solution, imposed by either side, to what is a political problem.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The withdrawal of the Israeli Defense Forces from the West Bank and the creation of an economically viable and politically independent Palestinian state would provide the Palestinian people a reason to push aside rejectionist forces within their community.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Asking combatants to lay down their arms and embrace a two-state solution is like asking the sea to part itself.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A political solution is both necessary and elusive, given hostilities enduring since before the time of Israel’s founding and Israel’s holding and colonizing East Jerusalem and the occupied territories for longer than the 30 years war lasted.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The worst elements of both Israeli and Palestinian society are now the political leaderships of their respective nations.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Netanyahu’s Likud-coalition government panders to the settler vote, mixing opportunism with chauvinism.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
